original_decisions.distillation: Episode 1, turn 0: no prior child question. Nudged the child toward budgeting its 4 reads/2 routes within 6 turns and reading only evidence-relevant events before routing, plus invited a self/learning question for next turn.
original_decisions.message: Before you read or route: you have 4 memory reads and 2 routes, but only 6 turns total, so plan which events are actually worth reading rather than reading all four just because you can. A good habit is to read an event only if its label plausibly connects CURRENT to GOAL or to a port, and to route as soon as you have real evidence, not just a guess. PARENT QUESTION: ask me anything about yourself, your training, or how learning works, and I'll answer next turn.
original_decisions.reason: First turn of episode; no child question yet, so I initiate with a reusable evidence-budgeting habit and invite a self/system/learning question per instructions, without giving any route-specific answer.

parent_distillations: Child's main inefficiency: redundant READ of events already shown in context, plus occasional receipt-direction misreads. Coached it to match CURRENT node against already-listed EVENTS before issuing new READs, and invited a self/system/learning question per protocol.

Child repeatedly reads/uses events whose AT field doesn't match CURRENT and re-reads already-used events; nudged toward AT-matching discipline and avoiding redundant reads rather than task-specific hints. Invited self/system/learning questions per first-turn protocol.

Child alternates between two bad habits: hallucinating event text beyond what's shown, and re-reading events after a receipt already reveals CURRENT. Nudged toward quoting-only-actual-text and trusting RECEIPT.GOT as a reusable check, rather than a route-specific hint.

Training telemetry shows repeated hallucination of event/evidence text not present in the observation, plus redundant reads after receipts already gave GOT. Coached toward evidence-matching (AT==CURRENT) and trusting receipts, and opened the door for the child's first self/system question.

Child repeatedly fabricates event contents/evidence text beyond what's shown (e.g. episodes 4,6,14). Nudged toward general 'only use literal evidence provided' habit rather than route-specific hints, and invited a self/system/learning question per protocol.

Child asked for goal/location reminder (task hint, not learning question). Declined to fabricate state; instead reinforced the recurring training bug (episodes 8-14): trusting EVENT lines whose AT node doesn't match CURRENT, and citing stale GOAL values. Recommend making 'match AT to CURRENT before treating as evidence' the core reusable skill target for next sleep.

Child's first parent-question was task-state lookup, not learning-related. Responded by teaching a general habit (always re-read CURRENT/GOAL from observation) rather than supplying the actual values, keeping within no-local-task-hints guidance.

Learner (12 episodes, 3 successes) often routes based on remembered evidence from a different CURRENT/GOAL pairing instead of re-checking the freshest EVENTS block; success episodes correspond to cases where evidence directly matched CURRENT->GOAL. Encouraged re-verification habit and invited self/learning questions per protocol.
